# Pinned to Alliance wheelhouse availability. Install with:
#   pip install --no-index -r env/requirements.txt
#
# On Narval, the Alliance wheelhouse is the ONLY source for pytorch/numpy/pandas
# wheels — they are patched for the cluster. `--no-index` blocks PyPI fallback.
#
# Light pins: lower bounds only, so the Alliance wheelhouse version wins.

numpy>=1.26
pandas>=2.1
scipy>=1.11
scikit-learn>=1.3
matplotlib>=3.8
seaborn>=0.13
torch>=2.1

# PyOD is pulled from PyPI with its pinned deps — the Alliance wheelhouse
# usually has it, but if not, a second pass with `pip install pyod` (no
# --no-index) inside the venv is fine.
pyod>=1.1.0

# Notebook runtime (for the interactive layer)
jupyterlab
ipykernel
